q: Need a trend-following setup on the 15. When the 5 EMA crosses the 50 EMA, go long if flat and the 4h close is above its 20 EMA, or get short if flat and the 4h close is below its 20 EMA. Size in fixed 1 of equity per trade. Put a hard stop 1.5 ATR away at entry. Time-based exit kills the trade at the next open once 16 bars elapse since the signal bar. Also, an opposite signal just bails us out at the next open.

attempts.text: Need a trend-following setup on the 15. When the 5 EMA crosses the 50 EMA, go long if flat and the 4h close is above its 20 EMA, or get short if flat and the 4h close is below its 20 EMA. Size in fixed 1 of equity per trade. Put a hard stop 1.5 ATR away at entry. Time-based exit kills the trade at the next open once 16 bars elapse since the signal bar. Also, an opposite signal just bails us out at the next open.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: ema crossover. Bullish when the 5-bar ema of the close crosses above the 50-bar ema (it was at or below it on the previous bar and is strictly above it now); bearish on the mirror-image cross below.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Trend filter on completed 240-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 240-minute close is strictly above the 20-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: a fixed 1 of equity per trade.
- Protective stop 1.5 x entry ATR away from the entry price (below for longs, above for shorts).
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 16 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 16).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Listen up, we’re going long-only on this Donchian breakout. When the close prints above the highest high of the prior 96 bars, size in flat to long. Vol scaling is 0.25% of equity times close over two times the entry ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. If we're already holding and a bearish breakdown hits the lower 96-bar low, bail immediately. Otherwise, trail it: track the highest high from entry, and ratchet the stop 1.5 times the entry ATR behind that extreme.

attempts.text: Listen up, we’re going long-only on this Donchian breakout. When the close prints above the highest high of the prior 96 bars, size in flat to long. Vol scaling is 0.25% of equity times close over two times the entry ATR, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05. If we're already holding and a bearish breakdown hits the lower 96-bar low, bail immediately. Otherwise, trail it: track the highest high from entry, and ratchet the stop 1.5 times the entry ATR behind that extreme.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 96 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 96 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Position size: volatility-scaled. Fraction of equity = 0.0025 x close / (2 x ATR(14)) on the signal bar, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05.
- Trailing stop: track the best price of the trade (highest high for longs, lowest low for shorts, starting from the entry price and updated with each bar's high/low while the position is held); the stop sits 1.5 x entry ATR behind that extreme.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

q: Need a long-only systematic model running on the 15 using MACD 5-35-5 crossovers. Size in at 75% equity on bullish crosses when flat, provided we are past the 96-bar cooldown from the last exit. Anchor a trailing box at entry with a 1 ATR stop and 2 ATR target. Every time price closes at least another 2 ATR in the green past the current anchor, ratchet the whole box up by 2 steps of 2 ATR. Bearish crosses or a 128-bar time stop exit us at the next open.

attempts.text: Need a long-only systematic model running on the 15 using MACD 5-35-5 crossovers. Size in at 75% equity on bullish crosses when flat, provided we are past the 96-bar cooldown from the last exit. Anchor a trailing box at entry with a 1 ATR stop and 2 ATR target. Every time price closes at least another 2 ATR in the green past the current anchor, ratchet the whole box up by 2 steps of 2 ATR. Bearish crosses or a 128-bar time stop exit us at the next open.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: MACD(5,35,5) line crossing its signal line. Bullish when the MACD line crosses above the signal line (at or below on the previous bar, strictly above now); bearish on the cross below.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Position size: a fixed 0.75 of equity per trade.
- Moving box: the trade lives in a box anchored at the entry price, with the stop 1 x entry ATR behind the anchor and the target 2 x entry ATR beyond it. Every time a bar closes at least another 2 x entry ATR in profit beyond the current anchor, shift the whole box (anchor, stop and target) 2 x entry ATR in the trade's favour (repeat if the close cleared several steps). The box never shifts back.
- Cooldown: after any trade ends, take no new entry for 96 bars, counted from the bar on which you first see yourself flat (entries allowed again from that bar + 96).
- Time stop: if the trade is still open 128 bars after the signal bar, exit at the next open (decide on the bar where bars-since-signal reaches 128).
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

Size in at 50% equity whenever price breaks above the 48-bar highest high, but only if the completed 1h candle is above its 20-period EMA for the trend filter. Set the TP at 2 ATR using the entry vol. If a bearish 48-bar breakdown fires while we are long, get flat on the next open.

- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).

q: Listen, spin up a Donchian breakout system on the 15 using a 96-bar lookback for new highs and lows both ways, but throw a trend filter on the 1h where the latest completed close has to be above the 50 EMA for longs and below for shorts. When flat, fire off a half size entry on a breakout, and once we're in the green, pyramid and size up by another 0.5 once price moves at least 1 ATR in our favor, capped at 1 add per trade. Slap a hard TP at 6 ATR from entry, and if we catch an opposite Donchian signal while in a trade, bail and get flat.

When flat, fire off a half size entry on a breakout, and once we're in the green, pyramid and size up by another 0.5 once price moves at least 1 ATR in our favor, capped at 1 add per trade. Slap a hard TP at 6 ATR from entry, and if we catch an opposite Donchian signal while in a trade, bail and get flat.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: Donchian channel breakout. Bullish whenever the close is strictly above the highest high of the 96 bars before the current bar; bearish whenever the close is strictly below the lowest low of those 96 bars. This is a level condition, true on every bar it holds.
- Direction: long and short (a bullish signal opens a long when flat, a bearish one opens a short when flat).
- Trend filter on completed 60-minute candles: only take long entries when the last completed 60-minute close is strictly above the 50-period EMA of those candles' closes, and only take short entries when it is strictly below. The filter only blocks entries, never exits.
- Position size: start with 0.5 of equity, then pyramid. While in the trade, each time the close is at least 1 x the entry ATR beyond the price of the last add (initially the entry price) in the trade's favour, add another 0.5 (total capped at 1.0), at most 1 add(s) per trade; the add price becomes that bar's close.
- Take-profit order 6 x entry ATR beyond the entry price.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.

Need a long-only box breakout on the 15 where the 32-bar range box height is at most 3 times ATR. Fire when price is above the box top, but only if we're flat and haven't hit the 2 entries per UTC day cap. Size in vol-scaled at 0.25% of equity times close over 1 ATR, floored at 5% and capped at 100%. Hard stop 2 ATR away and TP 4 ATR away using entry ATR with multiplier 1. Flip short just flattens us.

spec_desc:
- Entry signal: range-box breakout. The box is the highest high and lowest low of the 32 bars before the current bar. It only counts as a box if its height (top minus bottom) is at most 3 times the current ATR(14). Bullish when the close is strictly above the top of a valid box; bearish when the close is strictly below its bottom.
- Direction: long only (bearish signals only close longs).
- Position size: volatility-scaled. Fraction of equity = 0.0025 x close / (1 x ATR(14)) on the signal bar, capped at 1.0 and floored at 0.05.
- Daily cap: at most 2 new entries per UTC calendar day (by the signal bar's open time); further signals that day are ignored.
- Protective stop 2 x entry ATR away from the entry price (below for longs, above for shorts).
- Take-profit order 4 x entry ATR beyond the entry price.
- A signal in the opposite direction of an open trade closes it at the next open.
